Method of Attack: Inserts malware in firmware of low-cost Android devices
Runs from /system folder with full root rights
Connects to remote server to download XML file
Installs apps mentioned in XML without user interaction
Apps display ads on top of other apps or Android interface
Avoids infecting devices with Chinese language or IP
Infects devices opportunistically during firmware windows
Impacted Systems: Low-cost Android smartphones and tablets with MediaTek chipsets
Date of Discovery: Report released in 2018 (two years after initial discovery)
Indicators of Compromise: Infected devices found in over 90 countries
